name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: Reveal optional detail with a standalone disclosure.

motionProfile.reason: Each disclosure shell owns one measured block size while its retained inner body owns the content paint; the trigger keeps its own colour and display owners.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: Collapsible integrates one opacity entrance at its retained inner content paint when the panel opens.

exit.fade/one-shot.reason: Collapsible fades its own inner content paint while the primitive still retains the closing panel.

geometry.resize/measured.reason: The panel shell owns one measured block-size transaction over its natural inner body while open and idle.

state.color/css-transition.reason: Defined trigger surface and foreground paint transition under one focus-aware colour owner.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Directly owned plain trigger and body strings replace only their changed graphemes.

number.roll/reels.reason: A supported direct numeric trigger or body quantity rolls only its changed places.
